data.body:
**[P2] Move ON_CHANGE exports off the checkpoint callback**

`onOperationChange` runs while checkpoint processing still holds its polling monitor, before pollers and checkpoint bookkeeping finish. Synchronous S3/Logs export and flush therefore delay durable progress. Operation completion can also wake the handler concurrently, allowing this RUNNING export to finish after—and overwrite—the terminal S3 record. Queue/coalesce immutable snapshots, serialize exports outside this hook, and drain/flush them from the awaited `onInvocationEnd`; add a delayed-exporter race test.
